这个工作流程有点迟了，我已经坐了很长一段时间了。然而，我仍然想稍微完善一下并实际发布它，所以就在这里。

这本质上只是 Anima 的 txt2img 工作流程，具有一些功能：

  • 艺术家/品质/gentags的处理

  • 优化设置，如sage attn、int8等

  • 附加 A1111 样式元数据的图像输出

  • 细节部分和升级部分

没什么好说的；如果您熟悉我的 NoobAI/Illustrious 工作流程，那么这在很多方面基本上与此类似。

在我启动的快速 Pod 上进行了测试和验证，所有自定义节点都应该没问题。

编辑 08/09/2026：我注意到在最新的前端版本上，解析主机已损坏，该节点已被替换。

编辑 08/25/2026：用 SeedVR2 的核心实现替换 SeedVR2 高档节点；由于核心节点具有适当的延迟评估，因此将 Easy-Use 的 if/else 节点全面替换为核心 if/else 节点。这有望减少对自定义节点的依赖。

o.en:
Note: refer to the notes in the workflow and the readme included in the workflow.

This workflow is a bit overdue and I was sitting on it for a decent while. However, I still wanted to polish it up a bit and actually release it, so here it is.

This is essentially just a txt2img workflow for Anima, with some features:

  • Handling of artist/quality/gentags

  • Optimization settings, such as sage attn, int8, etc.

  • Images output with A1111-style metadata attached

  • Detailer and upscaler sections

Not much else to say; if you're familiar with my NoobAI/Illustrious workflows, this is basically similar to that in many regards.

Tested and verified working on a quick pod I spun up, all custom nodes should be fine.

EDIT 08/09/2026: I have noticed that resolution-master is broken on the latest frontend version, that node has been replaced.

EDIT 08/25/2026: Replaced the SeedVR2 upscale node with the core implementation of SeedVR2; replaced Easy-Use's if/else nodes across the board with the core if/else nodes now that the core nodes have proper lazy eval. This should hopefully reduce some dependence on custom nodes.
